'''Xorth''' was a [[Agriworld/Legends|agriworld]] located within the [[Xorth system/Legends|Xorth system]] of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]].<ref name="TSC" />

==Description==
Xorth was a world with a rich soil, making it an important agriworld. The planet's trade was largely in agricultural goods. It was noteworthy for being the source of the best [[Farrberry|farrberries]] available in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="TSC" />

It was at the intersection of the [[Agricultural Circuit]] and the [[Corellian Run/Legends|Corellian Run]].<ref name="TEA" />

==History==
Xorth joined the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] prior to the [[Indecta Era]]. During the [[Alsakan Conflicts/Legends|Alsakan Conflicts]], it supported [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="TEGtW" />

During the height of the [[New Order/Legends|New Order]], Xorth was an example of prosperous, secure and growing [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] Core planet.<ref name="TSC" />
